newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil up with IPE, backwardation dulls trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil up with IPE, backwardation dulls trade.

text.p: NWE gas oil firmed sharply on Wednesday as benchmark futures made another gaint leap amid concerns over low heating oil stock levels both in Europe and the U.S.
IPE Oct futures climbed $7.50 to close at $243.25 a tonne, and the Oct/Nov backwardation widened further to a huge $12.
German heating oil was bid at Nov IPE +$8.50 a tonne cif Hamburg, but no offers were forthcoming with sellers reluctant to talk November-related numbers.
Heating oil barges traded at Oct IPE +$7.50 fob ARA, but volumes were small.
"The backwardation is really putting a brake on this market, but we know that at some point people will just have to buy," a trader said.
Low sulphur diesel was scarce and prices held firm after a -7/-22 cargo traded into Hamburg at Oct IPE +$20.50 on Tuesday. An intermediate grade barge sold at Oct +$17 fob Antwerp.

But Russian heating oil was valued much lower after a cargo traded into Amsterdam on Tuesday at Oct +$3. Buyers shunned a m/m-priced cargo offered into the German Baltic while another cargo was heard offered at just Nov IPE +$8 cif NWE.
